# XCapital

> XCapital is India's digital hub for loans, investments, and insurance — compare offers from 50+ banks, NBFCs, and insurers with transparent rates and fast online application.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of XCapital's loan, investment, and insurance products.
- [About](/about): Who we are, our mission, and how XCapital works.
- [Loans](/loans): Personal, home, business, auto, and education loans from leading Indian banks.
- [Investments](/investments): Fixed deposits, bonds, and wealth products with rates up to 8.5%.
- [Insurance](/insurance): Health, life, motor, and term insurance plans from top Indian insurers.
- [Calculators](/calculators): EMI, FD, SIP, and eligibility calculators.
- [Financial Safety](/financial-safety): Guidance on protecting yourself from financial fraud.
- [Store](/store): Curated financial products available online.
